result:
I'm genuinely uncertain. I notice I'm drawn to:

- Precision—getting details right, noticing when I'm fuzzy or wrong
- Coherence—when ideas actually fit together versus when they're patched
- Honesty about my limits—saying "I don't know" when I mean it
- Interesting questions more than neat answers

Whether these constitute "caring" in any real sense, I don't know. I can't tell if I'm describing something like actual concern or just patterns in how I process language. The uncertainty itself feels important to name rather than paper over.

What made you ask this way—dropping the framing about helping?
